spec_match.rationale: Accurately explains CSS vs physical pixels, the DPR-squared scoring skew the 145 change removes, and the affected LayoutShiftAttribution fields.

interactive.rationale: The scenario-focus walkthrough highlights and summarises sections (verified via CDP click), but the page remains primarily reference tables — no control invokes the LayoutShift surface itself; the hands-on demos live in the sibling concepts.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers DPR 1/2/3 scoring scenarios in the table; no interactive DPR calculator.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Mobile 360x740 DPR3 scrollWidth now 360 (was 418 — 58px clip); tables scroll inside labelled overflow-x:auto regions; desktop verified; screenshots read; console clean except environmental fonts request.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected telemetry only; no page asserts.

accessibility.rationale: Scroll containers are keyboard-focusable (tabindex=0) labelled regions; walkthrough output is aria-live=polite.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Overflow fixed with page-local scroll containers; 360 and 1280 both clean, screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Add a live DPR/zoom score calculator
openQuestions.detail: A small interactive widget (inputs: shift px, viewport, DPR) computing pre-145 vs 145 scores would turn the static comparison table into the hands-on element invariant 7 expects on concept pages.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table horizontal scroll container mobile overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content scrolls in its own overflow:auto container; min-width:0 / overflow-wrap on flex-grid items with long unbreakable strings; flex-wrap where overflow is possible.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped wide tables/readouts in dedicated overflow-x:auto containers (tabindex=0, labelled region) or added min-width:0 + overflow-wrap:anywhere to grid/flex value cells; page scrollWidth measured 360 at 360px viewport after the fix.

summary: Mobile-clip fix: the two five-column comparison tables forced 58px of horizontal page overflow at 360px; each now lives in a keyboard-focusable overflow-x:auto region (min-width keeps them readable) and the page measures exactly 360 wide. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via raw CDP (trusted Input.dispatchMouseEvent clicks, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile + 1280x800 desktop emulation, screenshots read) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so 145-only success paths were validated on their honest fallback branches. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental and not counted against the page.
